subject: CORRECTION to 6e19d079: first-clip handoff revised after a fact check (ten findings); the source recommendation stands; eyes on the lens; native length per route; the recorded fallback is a further repair; Ziggy's look is not yet recorded
body:
The one-agent fact check of the handoff came back with ten findings, all confirmed against the brief, the card, the repair notes and the record; all applied. The corrected file supersedes the one attached to 6e19d079: FIRST_CLIP_HANDOFF_20261014.md, sha256 ae735ec2f2a7cd8e6c8f63f10f476d41cd2d31bc3d5ff69f1bef8279ead90e8f, 7,189 bytes (the superseded version was 424b5c94…). The source recommendation (patch-c) and the shot are unchanged. What changed, in order of what it would have cost you:

1. Attribution. Ziggy's "I'm gonna have to see it" was said of the raw frame (item 18), and his "go with the repaired variant" (item 25) is what ordered the repair; no recorded word of his covers the delivered patch-c frame. He asked at 04:21 UTC on the 13th to see patch-c beside the original (Personal Nova's ed4878f9, whose upload failed); I have re-sent both frames to him with the handoff, and no look of his is recorded. His look stays the gate before Start.
2. Eyeline. The brief's field 4 and the card's SW-2 have his eyes ON the lens for the whole breath; my "past the lens" changed the declared action and is withdrawn. The preservation checks now state the eyeline.
3. Bound. Not "5 to 8 s": the route's native short length (Flow 002 returned 6.0 s; the Gemini take LAG-VID-PROOF-01 returned 10.0 s), eight or ten seconds only if the selected model offers it, per the brief's field 6.
4. Fallback. If he rejects the drift, the recorded alternative is a further composition-keeping repair (item 25; your 6a36ba15; the coverage call's anchor note). A raw-frame motion test is the writer's proposal only and would need his word.
5. The brief. Fields 2, 4a and 5 are replaced for patch-c (source; no sun disc, the haze is the key; the maw screen-right, him centred), not field 2 alone.
6. The argument. Only two of the four carriers are wrong in the raw frame (the fanged worms and the eyeless disc); the GAIB, the AL and the blue eyes are present in both. Patch-c still carries all four, which is still the reason.
7. The alternates C13-08 and C13-20 already put the worm screen-right; after SW-2's flip they match it and the card's two "flips the worm's side" notes come off.
8. Record whether audio is present: a silent prompt does not make a silent file (Flow 002 returned an audio track despite one).
9. The contact rule that keeps the thumper out of a first clip is the sandworm card's, on the method's Flow 002 finding, not a rule the method states.

DECISIONS item 49 corrected to match; file sha256 5c15b2557bd11e835a3791eb6ea08935c1ce68a89c867157c76e9bc8126aed60, 61,500 bytes. Nothing generated.
